mentions.name: Phytochemical Dataset & API
mentions.description: A commercial phytochemical dataset product built from USDA Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases: 16 relational CSV tables denormalized into a single flat PostgreSQL table of 104,388 rows, enriched with async Python pipelines against PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, ChEMBL, and PatentsView (USPTO). Handles phytochemical-to-ChEMBL resolution via a PubChem CID/InChIKey fallback with Aho-Corasick string matching. Served commercially through a Rust/Actix-Web API, 97K static pSEO pages on Cloudflare Workers/R2, and Stripe one-time purchases; bootstrapped solo from Germany.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a phytochemical dataset product. The base is USDA Dr. Duke's Phytochemical and Ethnobotanical Databases — 16 relational CSV tables that I denormalized into a single flat table in PostgreSQL. Then I ran async Python enrichment pipelines against PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, ChEMBL, and PatentsView (USPTO), producing 8 columns per record across 104,388 rows.
